title: Adding A Video Above The Fold Of The Homepage
text:
## Adding A Video Above The Fold Of The Homepage
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000686290
First, hide the entire first section by navigating to Settings >> Design Settings >>  Search Box / Call to Action >> Hide Entire Section :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089359575/original/cCSXlUBmHOjXyySLo1Yx0vmbLaqPRD7ifA.png?1614440575 | alt: ]
Add the video as Custom Homepage Content. To start this process, navigate to Content >> Webpage Builder >> Edit Homepage :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086114456/original/m43mTlCWd9YwxOTmMN7c-Oh2ocKIC2dyOw.png?1607562745 | alt: ]
Add the Video using the Coding Icon < >
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089359716/original/_SqD-pxTclcooURZN6ui5sinJeISpL7jVQ.png?1614441210 | alt: ]
In order to make the video larger and match the width of the rest of the elements in the homepage, replace the width and height:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089359719/original/T-UMDwQ-qQFa7WvL08CJxD0cjHPLsx_3Sg.png?1614441219 | alt: ]
Also make sure to remove or add a different Title H1 and Subtitle H2:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089359703/original/25CjKIh7uId3_osf0IYar9QgbY1KlRcCjQ.png?1614441128 | alt: ]
The last step will be to call this section as custom homepage content. To do this navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage >> Select Content to Display >> Select: Custom Homepage Content
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089359755/original/XUJ03z6yHWFnMf4zcPcpfCHCKVybrdbBDA.png?1614441383 | alt: ]
Now you can Visit the Site, the end result is the video above the fold:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089359816/original/PIzx4nqQAfTedHvGYzxmpkE7w4RPmweJMA.png?1614441550 | alt: ]
